summary: Sodankyla Airport (SOT/EFSO) is a regional airport serving the municipality of Sodankyla in Finnish Lapland, located well above the Arctic Circle. It functions as a gateway for Lapland tourism, scientific research missions, and small-scale scheduled flights, providing access to one of Finland's prime wilderness and aurora-viewing regions. The airport supports visits to nearby Pyhä-Luosto National Park, Lake Inari, and Sami cultural sites.
